Fueling Deicing

บ่อพักน้ำมันเชื้อเพลิง

A low point or reservoir in an aircraft fuel tank or system where water, debris, and contaminants collect and can be drained during preflight checks.

Quick answer: A low point or reservoir in an aircraft fuel tank or system where water, debris, and contaminants collect and can be drained during preflight checks.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A low point or reservoir in an aircraft fuel tank or system where water, debris, and contaminants collect and can be drained during preflight checks.

Operational example

Pilot, drain the fuel sump prior to start and check for water or sediment as part of the preflight inspection.

Localized term
